acord-completeness.name: ACORD Completeness
acord-completeness.description: Index ACORD and application PDFs, list form number, named insured as written, and blank required boxes.

certificate-holder-batch.name: Certificate Holder Batch
certificate-holder-batch.description: Batch the holder list against their COI form for one named client or job list.

coi-request-pack.name: COI Request Pack
coi-request-pack.description: Assemble one certificate request: holder as written, job or contract name, and the COI form they use.

endorsement-request-list.name: Endorsement Request List
endorsement-request-list.description: List open policy-change requests from their endorsement sheet with type, effective date, and supporting-doc status.

expiration-list.name: Expiration List
expiration-list.description: Build the expiration list from their expiration CSV: policy, named insured, and expiration date as exported.

fnol-routing.name: FNOL Routing
fnol-routing.description: From their claim log and loss-notice PDFs, list date of loss, policy number, missing fields, and where to send the notice.

missing-dec-pages.name: Missing Dec Pages
missing-dec-pages.description: Compare the AMS policy list to the dec-page folder and list issued or in-force rows with no current-term dec PDF.

renewal-pipeline.name: Renewal Pipeline
renewal-pipeline.description: Join their AMS export to the expiration CSV. Keep producer, CSR, line, and status as they coded it.

vehicle-add-paperwork.name: Vehicle Add Paperwork
vehicle-add-paperwork.description: From the endorsement sheet, list each vehicle add: VIN as provided, requested effective date, and title or registration present.
